body.name: Observed-cell Chen program for the one-stage reduction
body.construction: For \(H=1\), \(S_2\) plays the role of Chen's always-observed \(F\). For each \((s,a)\in\mathcal X_{SA}(p)\), set \(A_{s,a}[s',r]=p(M_1=1,S_2=s',R_1=r\mid S_1=s,A_1=a)\) and \(\boldsymbol\beta_{s,a}[s']=p(M_1=0,S_2=s'\mid S_1=s,A_1=a)\). Then \(\mathcal W_{s,a}=\{w\in\mathbb R_+^{|\mathcal R|}:A_{s,a}w=\boldsymbol\beta_{s,a}\}\) and \(\mathcal J_{s,a}=\{\mathbf 1^\top A_{s,a}\operatorname{diag}((r)_{r\in\mathcal R})(w+\mathbf 1):w\in\mathcal W_{s,a}\}\).
